title: Retrospective treatment-link retrieval

metrics.uncertainty: Percentile bootstrap, diseases as clusters, 2,000 replicates

metrics.uncertainty: Percentile bootstrap, diseases as clusters, 2,000 replicates

metrics.uncertainty: Percentile bootstrap, diseases as clusters, 2,000 replicates

metrics.name: Direct-overlap baseline
metrics.uncertainty: Percentile bootstrap, diseases as clusters, 2,000 replicates

protocol.task: Recover held-out recorded treatment links from biological evidence paths
protocol.split_unit: Compound–disease pair, shuffled with a fixed seed
protocol.graph: All evidence edges retained; TREATS and PALLIATES absent from all feature matrices and graph projections
protocol.candidate_universe: All 1,552 compounds, including compounds with no paths; mask train and validation positives for each test disease
protocol.ties: Score descending, then namespace-qualified compound ID ascending
protocol.multiple_positives: Other test positives remain in the candidate ranking
protocol.unobserved_sampling: Up to 10 disease-matched unobserved pairs per training positive, without replacement per disease; all recorded positives excluded
protocol.negative_label_meaning: Unobserved in this dataset, not established ineffective
protocol.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted on training pairs only
protocol.hyperparameters: C in [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10], selected by validation MRR
protocol.metrics: Micro Recall@10 and mean reciprocal rank over held-out positive links
protocol.ablation: Same saved coefficients and scaler; family removal changes exact counts and affected degrees
protocol.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals, 2,000 replicates; diseases resampled as clusters to preserve correlated links. Intervals describe this fixed split.
protocol.llm_role: None in ranking, fitting, split selection, or evaluation

feature_definitions.direct: C-BINDS-G-ASSOCIATES-D; exact number of shared genes

limitations: Retrospective recovery is not clinical efficacy validation or new drug discovery.
The evidence graph is historical and transductive; this is not a temporal or unseen-disease generalization test.
Removing indication edges prevents direct graph leakage, but correlated literature curation can still encode prior medical knowledge.
Unobserved pairs can contain real but undocumented treatments; retrieval scores are not calibrated probabilities.
A single fixed split has sampling uncertainty. All test links and failures are retained in the report.
Dense well-studied biology receives more coverage. Source relationships are consolidated observations, not independent studies.
Evidence-family ablation measures model sensitivity, not causal biological interventions.
Binding and association edges do not encode beneficial action direction, dose, safety, contraindications, or tissue specificity. High-ranking compounds can be medically inappropriate.
